assertion.statement: Release 0.16.0 of external-secrets bumps the Go toolchain version the project builds with to 1.24.2.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence is a single 'chore' line naming no environment-facing condition (no Helm value, resource, flag, or customer-visible version requirement) that determines which environments are exposed to this build-toolchain bump.; consequence: The evidence states only that the Go version was bumped; it says nothing about what happens (or fails) for an environment whose operator does nothing.
